checkpoints.description: [1/6] Scaffold falsification-first repo, claim ledger, formula registry, and symbolic core for claims 1-2

impact_assessment.why: The user wants a reproducible, falsification-first research codebase for a Z3 circulant/Koide hypothesis with a separable nematic-fluid UV track; without a ledger and formula registry, claims cannot be audited.
impact_assessment.benefits: Auditable claim statuses, machine-checked algebra, and a reproducible base for PDG and RG work.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new project only, no AIKit core edits; dependency: sympy/numpy/scipy/hypothesis added to project pyproject; concurrency: single agent, no shared files; state: new repo, ledger checkpointed before writes
impact_assessment.mitigation: Declare deps in pyproject, keep all claims in claims.md, regenerate every number from scripts, run pytest before any commit.

[1/4] Build validated 1D simulation core: sine-Gordon kink, gradient check, monotone flow, Hessian; rotor cross-check

impact_assessment.why: Claim 15 requires a validated simulation core before any 3D or production run; the repository currently has no core and earlier lost-run numbers are inadmissible.
impact_assessment.benefits: Reusable tested core, quantitative baselines, and a defensible base for the Hopf estimator and 3D runs.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: sims only, no claim changes beyond validation; dependency: numpy/scipy already declared; concurrency: none; state: new results/sim_core.json/md and tests; numerical: discretization and boundary conditions
impact_assessment.mitigation: Fix Dirichlet boundary values from the analytic profile; verify energy convergence in N; finite-difference gradient check <1e-6; small explicit time step; test Hessian symmetry and eps/N stability.
